info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AlloyDB API (v1) discovery document. Every other official method returns HTTP 501 UNIMPLEMENTED. Clusters, instances and users are configuration metadata: no PostgreSQL engine, network endpoint, storage or backup is created; instances report READY immediately. Long-running operations complete synchronously and remain readable through operations.get/list. User passwords are refused and never stored; delete a cluster with children only with force=true.
info.title: AlloyDB for PostgreSQL (simulator catalog)
